_comment: Curated supplement: community cores NOT in the openFPGA Cores Inventory but verified to publish a downloadable openFPGA GitHub release zip (checked against repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/latest). Merged into cores.json by scripts/Update-CoresManifest.ps1 (deduped by owner/repo; inventory entries win on conflict). platformIds are left empty where the exact ROM platform isn't confidently known - ROM import for those is still offered post-install from the core's own declared platform (see issue #128). Entries from the user-supplied wishlist that point at non-existent repos (e.g. several boogermann/corenal/piercecolin/Raki-PCE/coinopcollection names) or non-release distribution (jotego cores ship via jotego/jtbin, not per-repo zips) are intentionally omitted - they cannot be auto-downloaded by the standard path.
